detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

AOD9604 (Aqueous Solution)

Chemical Information:

  • Molecular Formula: C₇₈H₁₂₃N₂₃O₂₃S₂
  • Molecular Weight: 1815.08 g/mol
  • Sequence: Tyr-Gly-Phe-Gly-Gly-Pro-Ser-Val-Thr-Leu-Leu-Lys-Gln-Leu

Molecular Structure:

 

 

Product Description:

AOD9604 is a synthetic peptide analog derived from the C-terminal region (176–191) of human growth hormone (HGH), consisting of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. The compound incorporates structural modifications relative to the native fragment and is not identical to endogenous HGH or its naturally occurring derivatives. It is structurally characterized and utilized in laboratory research settings for analytical and experimental evaluation under controlled conditions. This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, designed to provide consistency and stability for controlled research applications. No therapeutic, diagnostic, or clinical claims are made or implied.

Research Applications:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models

Storage and Handling:

  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Maintain sterile handling practices during research use

Product Specifications:

  • Bottle Volume: 15 mL
  • Total Content: 20 mg per bottle
  • Dispenses per Container: ~100
  • Per Dispense: ~200 mcg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.

Compliance Notice:

AOD9604 (Aqueous Solution) is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
